title: Retrieval as a Decision: Training-Free Adaptive Gating for Efficient RAG
authors: Yufeng Wang; Lu wei; Haibin Ling
why_relevant: Proposes a training-free adaptive gating policy that decides when to retrieve based on prefix-logit uncertainty (entropy, margin, small-N variance), directly addressing calibration/control of retrieval decisions.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on efficiency and when-to-retrieve, not on handling noisy/adversarial evidence once retrieved.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control: When to Retrieve
